title: JBS Australia driving conversation on the main stage at BeefEx2026

body_markdown:
JBS Northern had team members from across its feedlot network and Northern Operations representing the business at this year's BeefEx Conference; a celebration of the lot feeding and grain fed beef industry. The conference presents the opportunity to engage with industry peers, customers and suppliers, and share insights on the opportunities and challenges facing the sector.


BeefEx 2026 drew a record crowd of 1,200 attendees, with JBS Northern well represented on the conference program as COO Brendan Tatt **** joined a panel alongside Australian Lot Feeders Association CEO Christian Mulders and Meat and Livestock Australia General Manager of International Andrew Cox. The Chaos, Capital and Cattle panel allowed Brendan to provide a commercial perspective to discussions around the challenges facing the lot feeding sector at present, as well as the exciting opportunities available as the industry continues to grow.


Edwin Cooke, JBS Northern General Manager of Livestock also took to the stage, talking through the importance of pre-vaccination and the vital role they plays in animal welfare and favourable outcomes at processing.


Events like BeefEx provide an important opportunity to learn, collaborate and strengthen the relationships that underpin the industry's success, and with leaders of JBS contributing to the conversation, it cements the businesses position as Australia’s largest lot feeder.
